title: 420Explorer current-main reconciliation and exact-head requalification
reconciliation_rules: The recorded current main commit must be an ancestor of the exact qualification head.
The EXP-0.4.8 final qualified head must remain an ancestor of the exact qualification head.
No commit from current main may be missing from the qualification head.
EXP-0.4 branch changes since current main must remain confined to Explorer audit records, EXP-0.4 verifier scripts and the retained 420Indexer qualification workflow.
The retained verifier chain must include EXP-0.4.1 through EXP-0.4.9 in order.
Current-main reconciliation does not promote runtime, deployment, live-network or Genesis state.
The exact requalification head must pass 420Indexer, 420Docs Qualification and all four 420 Integrated Qualification jobs.

allowed_delta.rationale: EXP-0.4 is an audit/evidence reconciliation stage; no product/runtime source change is required for current-main requalification.

required_requalification_workflows.name: 420Indexer
required_requalification_workflows.scope: primary Explorer/Indexer source, integration and retained audit verifier chain

promotion_boundary: EXP-0.4.9 proves repository reconciliation and exact-head regression against the current main ancestry only. It does not close later runtime/deployment/live Genesis requirements.

qualification.scope: current-main ancestry reconciliation and exact-head repository requalification only
limitations: does not establish runtime, deployment, live-network or Genesis qualification
does not resolve any of the ten active Genesis blockers
does not satisfy AC-1 through AC-10
qualification.note: Recording this evidence changes the branch head. The resulting exact head must rerun all retained qualification gates before EXP-0.4.9 is marked COMPLETE.
